registered_rules.double_touch: stop wins when a bar touches stop and target
registered_rules.entry_bar: the decision bar is not barrier-eligible; the next-open entry bar is
registered_rules.eligibility: 09:45 inclusive, 14:55 exclusive, and 11:00 inclusive through 12:00 exclusive
registered_rules.halt: realized daily loss reaches -5R and blocks entries from the next bar
registered_rules.timeout: min(60 bars, last same-session bar) at close
registered_rules.zero_day: zero-trade sessions remain in the daily series
registered_rules.stress: re-cost accepted trades without changing the trade set
